The low budget film attempts to transform the Pacific Northwest Sasquatch man-beast into an old-fashioned movie monster, ala King Kong (as a quote on the original movie poster proudly trumpets) or Godzilla,Gamera,Yonggary.  A remake of sorts was produced in 2012.
